newMessages.content: The soil moisture readings from sensor 3 in the east field dropped below 40% field capacity overnight. With the heat wave forecast for the next 5 days, I think we need to bump the irrigation cycle from every 3 days to every 2 days. But the pump can only run 16 hours a day — can we fit the extra cycle in?
